# L5 refit `vivado-2025.2`

Generated by `python -m hw_dse.synth.recalibrate`. New calibration: `src/hw_dse/models/calibration_artix7_refit_vivado-2025.2.yaml` (fitted on 51 points). The default cost model is unchanged (`artix7-xc7a35t-vivado2025.2-2anchor-v1`).

## Constants

| constant | M1 (2 anchors) | refit (global) |
|---|---|---|
| c_arith | 1.0537 | 1.0012 |
| c_mux | 0.7541 | 0.9394 |
| c_ff | 1.0089 | 0.9995 |
| t_logic_ns | 0.8842 | 0.7764 |
| t_mux_ns | 1.1313 | 1.0405 |

Per-family overrides: `iterative`: c_arith=0.9183, c_ff=1.0617, t_logic_ns=1.0905, `pipelined`: c_arith=0.9898, c_ff=0.9431, t_logic_ns=0.7467, `pipelined_m`: c_arith=0.9845, c_ff=0.9833, t_logic_ns=0.8404, `unrolled_k`: c_arith=1.2248, c_ff=1.0142, t_logic_ns=0.6835

Tool corrections (measured ≈ factor × model, Vivado = 1): `vivado`: LUT ×1.000, FF ×1.000, path ×1.000; `yosys+nextpnr-xilinx`: LUT ×1.046, FF ×1.033, path ×1.417

Fit: every tool carries equal total weight; per-family overrides only for c_arith, c_ff and t_logic_ns, for families with >= 9 points. Vivado anchors used: none (superseded by generated-RTL Vivado rows)

Reported, not fitted: 14 Vivado post-route rows (tool `vivado post-route`; the anchors and the default model are post-synthesis), shown with no tool factor.

Counted once: `pipelined:data_width=16,n_iter=14,angle_guard=0,frac_guard=0,rounding=trunc` (vivado 2025.2) is in both `vivado_measured.csv` (kept) and `vivado_spotcheck.csv` (dropped); they agree within 0.5%.
